Description:
Stardew Valley Save Editor

Note:1.6 version is planned, please give us some time
[size=4]
Allows:[/size]
[font=Arial]Modifying of Save Files which Inlcudes, Map Editing (Move and Delete stuff for now). Adding and Changing Items in Your inventory. It also has an Autoupdater so you can keep up with new Releases. Comes with an Animal Happiness Modification and switching between a Cat or Dog. . Storage Container Editing (Chest/Fridge/ETC.)

[size=6][font=Arial]Backup Save Manager (Allows to Restore a Backup Save)[/font][/size]
It automatically Makes backups before any edits are done, if something breaks just use the backup manager, or check the backup folder.

Compatible with the latest version on All Console Versions (Yes Switch to.)

Image pack is not required but suggested. Without it, there will be no images, just Extract the zip and run the installer or just ﻿Copy and paste the STCM folder to %AppData%/StardewValley/

[u][size=5]Switch Notes:[/size][/u]
ReEncrypting the save is not necessary.

Switch -> PC | Version no changes neccessary
PC -> Switch | You have to hand edit and change the Save Version in the XML.

[u][size=5]Vita[/size][/u]
Sadly Vita is not going to get anymore updates, so you should probably use the older version here:
[url=https://stcodematrix.com/projects/zArchive/Stardew_Valley_Tools/SVEditor-WPF_1_0_0_85.zip]Link[/url]

[u][size=5]Playstation[/size][/u]
You have to use the save wizard or another tool to get the Raw Save, and remove the <encrypt> Tag from the end, then add that <encrypt> tag back in when done editing.
